item.title: Vertu Trophy Semi-Final and Final kick-off times confirmed
item.description: The Vertu Trophy Semi-Final ties have been confirmed. Doncaster Rovers v Stockport County will be played on Tuesday, 3 March at 8pm, live on Sky Sports Football. Luton Town/Plymouth Argyle v Northampton Town will take place on Wednesday, 4 March at 7.30pm, also live on Sky Sports Football. The winners of both games will meet at Wembley in the Vertu Trophy Final on Sunday 12 April at 3pm. item.title: Sky Bet Championship: Max Bird's stunner denies Wrexham
item.description: Tuesday night in the Sky Bet Championship saw a clash between two promotion chasers in Bristol City and Wrexham. Ashton Gate witnessed some fantastic goals as fans were treated to a four-goal thriller, the pick of which was Max Bird's late equaliser for the home side. Ollie Rathbone had given Wrexham a first-half lead, cancelled out by Sinclair Armstrong's smart strike just two minutes after the break.
